title: Age at the 3-digit limit
why: Checks the 3-digit maximum: 999 is accepted, 1000 is not.

steps.does: On UserCreated, register a passenger with Name 'Old Timer', PassportNumber 'O9990001', Male, Age 999; then try a second passenger with Age 1000 and PassportNumber 'O1000002'.

expect: Age 999 is accepted and saved; Age 1000 is rejected with a validation error on Age.
